page_text_ocr_zh:
一、
锯成两半儿的月亮
jù chéng liǎng bàn ér de yuè liang
page_text_en:
I.
A Moon Cut in Half
jù chéng liǎng bàn ér de yuè liang
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示章节标题“锯成两半儿的月亮”，背景为浅蓝色天空和云朵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙蹲在荷叶上，他数着池塘里的星星，一颗、两颗、三颗……数着数着，他打起了瞌睡。

当他睁开眼睛时，突然发现，池塘里的圆月亮不知被谁锯成两半儿了。

小青蛙惊慌地叫起来：“月亮被锯成两半儿了，月亮被锯成两半儿了！”

池塘里的鱼儿和树上的小鸟们听到吓了一跳，都探出脑袋瞧一瞧，说：“咦，月亮不是好好的吗？"
page_text_en:
The little frog sat on a lotus leaf, counting the stars in the pond—one, two, three... counting and counting, he dozed off.

When he opened his eyes, he suddenly noticed that the round moon in the pond had been sawn into two halves by someone.

The little frog cried out in panic: "The moon has been sawn into two halves! The moon has been sawn into two halves!"

The fish in the pond and the birds in the trees, hearing this, jumped in surprise, all peeking out to take a look, and said: "Hey, isn't the moon just fine?"
summary_zh: 小青蛙在荷叶上数星星睡着了，醒来发现池塘里的月亮被锯成两半，他惊慌大叫，鱼儿和小鸟们却觉得月亮好好的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙再抬头一瞧，圆圆的月亮
像个银盘一样，好好地挂在天上。
小青蛙难为情了，说：“我大概在
做梦！”
过了一会儿，他突然发现月亮又
被锯成两半儿了。
这次，他不再高声叫唤，而是仔细
地再看一看。
小青蛙终于看清了，是大雁排成
一个“一”字，正从圆月亮中间飞
过，圆月亮就好像被锯成了两半儿。
page_text_en:
The little frog looked up again. The round moon
looked like a silver plate, hanging nicely in the sky.
The little frog felt embarrassed and said, "I must have been
having a dream!"
After a while, he suddenly noticed the moon had
been sawed into two halves again.
This time, he didn't shout loudly, but instead carefully
looked again.
The little frog finally saw clearly: it was geese flying in
the shape of a "one", passing right through the middle of the round moon.
So the round moon looked as if it had been sawed into two halves.
summary_zh: 小青蛙发现月亮又好像被锯成两半，仔细观察后发现是大雁排成一字形飞过月亮造成的错觉。

page_text_ocr_zh: 小青蛙不再惊慌，他大声地笑了。他说：“我知道月亮是被谁锯成两半儿了……”
page_text_en: The little frog was no longer panicked. He laughed loudly. He said, "I know who sawed the moon into two halves..."
summary_zh: 小青蛙发现月亮被锯成两半的真相后，不再惊慌，开心地笑了，并宣布自己知道了真相。
